What role do you usually take on in co-op games?

My co-op group has four players, and we usually claim the same four roles. My brother is the medic or support class, assisting the team itself as directly as possible. Our other friend is the heavy, drawing fire whenever possible and putting himself right in the middle of things so that we don't have to. My cousin and I are both stealth players, but we divide up our roles there as well. He prefers to sit tight and cover an area with a sniper rifle or ranged class, and I prefer to keep mobile, getting objectives done and taking out key enemies while others hold the line.

From FPS games to RPGs, we always seem to find our roles to stick to, and it makes for a pretty efficient group.
